app_text.email_privacy_notice: You can play without email; a pseudonymous identifier is used to operate the app. Email is optional for quests and needed for daily draws and prize contact, not newsletters or advertising. A parent or guardian should provide their own email for a child. We keep email addresses and daily-draw records {retention}. Removing email leaves the draws. For additional info {contact} Read the full policy for data uses, providers and your rights.
app_text.draw_eligibility:
Participation requires personal presence at the event. No purchase is required to earn stars or enter the draws. There is no minimum age restriction; a parent or guardian must provide their own email and handle prize contact for children. A valid email is required for draw participation and winner contact. Connect to the internet before the draw so your entries can reach the organizer; entries stored only on your phone cannot be included in the server's draw pool.

Prize names are listed above. Each day's prize list is finalized before that day's draw begins.

Winners are contacted by email and have 14 days from the prize email to reply. If a winner does not reply within 14 days, the organizer will draw a replacement winner. Prizes can be collected in person before the expo ends or shipped by arrangement through email.

Progress applies to the current event and will be cleared manually by the organizer after the expo. Email is used for draws, prize delivery and support, not marketing. See the privacy policy for data handling and retention.
